page.overview:
What is Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides?

Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides is a subtheme of the Pirates of the Caribbean line. On Stranger Tides is the fourth film in the series, and was released on May 20, 2011. The subtheme so far has included five sets that were all released in the theme's first wave in April 2011. On Stranger Tides appears in LEGO Pirates of the Caribbean: The Video Game.

Jack Sparrow escapes custody in London before being forced aboard the Queen Anne's Revenge by his former love spark, Angelica and her father, the pirate all pirates fear, Blackbeard, who intends to use him to find the Fountain of Youth. Meanwhile, Hector Barbossa, now a privateer, is sent out in pursuit of the pirates.
